description: Samsite demo — stand a fresh session up end-to-end: seed the plugin GRIFT (AWS/GitHub/KSI/samsite pages + schedules), then fire the collectors that pull the live world in. Seed order is INSTALLED_APPS order; collector order matters: samsite-compliance reads aws_account nodes (boto3) AND content-matches github_workflow nodes (github_core), so both must run before it. INSTALL SOURCES — TEMPORARILY ALL EDITABLE (monorepo): the substrate refactors (compliance_core + identity_core extraction, aws_core edge prune, TRUSTS_ISSUER relocation) landed on core-main but have NOT been re-released to the plugin repos, so their pinned tags (github/aws/sigstore/fedramp @ v0.1.x) are stale and a git-sourced boot is version-skewed (old github_core__oidc_issuer vs new identity_core__oidc_issuer, missing compliance_core, etc.). Editable monorepo sources give one coherent current-code world so the demo boots. Flip each consumer back to {type:git, rev:vX.Y.Z} once the code-build CI re-releases the set (identity_core + compliance_core first — the two new substrate deps have no repos yet). Install set + seed path here match the test_all union, so they are proven by the cold-boot gate; only the fire-collector steps are demo-runtime (live AWS/GitHub/network).

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia). TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.lotr). Install-only: the demo/test-fixture vocabulary lotr's own suites + tap_web/tap_grid feature tests use as a concrete plugin example; installed so any env that boots samsite keeps tap_plugin.lotr importable. NOT seeded — Middle-earth data has no place in this customer-demo profile.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.computing_core). Vendor-neutral computing-primitive dimension; seeded in population. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.0, now stale after the edge-vocabulary prune.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.roscale). Install-only: registers the OSCAL workbench panel types samsite consumes; no grift seed, no collector, but samsite imports it at ready() — must be installed. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.0.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). Install-only substrate: cross-cutting federated-identity vocabulary (the oidc_issuer convergence node + issuer primitives) + the generic TRUSTS_ISSUER edge. github_core imports its issuer helper; sigstore_core/samsite reference identity_core__oidc_issuer. Listed before its consumers so its type registers first. No repo yet — must be released first when the set is re-evicted. No GRIFT population seed.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.aws_core). Tier-0 boto3 dep. AWS dimension + region reference data; seeded + fired in population. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.1, now stale after the edge prune + DIVIDED_INTO_AZ rename.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.sigstore_core). Tier-0 sigstore dep. Install-only library: samsite compliance_collector consumes its verify/decompose helpers + models; IDENTITY_VOUCHED_BY targets identity_core__oidc_issuer. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.0, now stale after the issuer retarget.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). Tier-0 PyYAML dep. AWS/GitHub Actions plumbing + the github collector; mints the oidc_issuer via identity_core and emits TRUSTS_ISSUER. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.0, now stale: the oidc_issuer model moved to identity_core.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.compliance_core). Install-only substrate: regime-agnostic compliance vocabulary (artifact/context/evidence/finding/exception/boundary). samsite's compliance_collector creates compliance_core__compliance_artifact nodes; fedramp_20x_ksi depends on it. Listed before them so its types register first. No repo yet — release first when the set is re-evicted. No GRIFT population seed.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.fedramp_20x_ksi). FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule; seeded + catalog fired in population. Depends on compliance_core. (Editable pending re-release — was git @ v0.1.1, now stale after the compliance_core extraction.)

Package-mode (tap_plugin.samsite). The demo integration surface; seeded in population. DEPENDS ON compliance_core/github_core/identity_core/roscale/sigstore_core at import time + aws_core nodes at runtime — listed last so its cross-plugin deps install first. Its collectors ARE fired in this profile (pull the live world in).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core suites build fixtures from. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. (gryphon_playground, which depends_on it, is NOT installed in this customer-demo profile — the Gryphon test corpus stands up via its own in-package boot records selected by a bootstrap pointer.)

steps.note: TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia.
AWS dimension + region reference data the boto3 collector lands resources into.
Samsite keystone, landing + compliance pages, per-type viewers, and the collector schedules.
FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule.
AWS resource graph (Route53/CloudFront/S3/Lambda/IAM/...) + the aws_account node the boundary membership depends on. A full multi-region pull can run well past the 90s default.
GitHub repository / Actions data behind the repo landing page.
Refresh the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (HTTPS, no credentials).

Signed /.well-known/ compliance artifacts (OSCAL SSP/POA&M, KSI signal, VDR). Fetches 5 artifacts + verifies sigstore signatures, so it gets a generous timeout. MUST run after boto3 (synthesizes SCOPED_TO_COMPLIANCE_BOUNDARY membership from the aws_account nodes) AND after github_core (sigstore_link resolves the signing github_workflow by content-match; if the workflow node isn't on the grid yet those edges are silently omitted).
